question: What capacities did the NFA-A and NFA-F lithium iron aluminum nickelate cathodes retain at 1C?
rendered: According to the document, the NFA-A (LiNi0.8Fe0.05Al0.15O2) variant maintained a capacity of ≈116 mAh g^−1 at high C-rates of 1C, and the NFA-F (LiNi0.8Fe0.15Al0.05O2, 5% Al) variant delivered a capacity of ≈81 mAh g^−1 at the same rate.
